description.narrative: (Moldova): .The Future Technologies Activity will support the urban-focused and technology driven sectors including ICT, light manufacturing, precision engineering, creative industries, and media. It will incorporate cross-pollination and collaboration between the numerous centers of excellence. Cross-sector collaboration along these lines can achieve exponential results, such as the case with Tekwill-derived technology development transferring into the agricultural and wine sectors...The Future Technologies activities has been reorganized and renamed. Assistance related to workforce development and private sector competitiveness has been subsumed by the Future Technologies Activity. Funding for the Future Technologies activity originates from: $4,000,000 Private Sector Competitiveness follow-on activity, $2,315,055 Tourism Activity, and $2,000,000 Workforce Development. ..This program will support JRS Goal 2 Strengthen and Balance the Transatlantic Trade and Investment Relationship by making Moldova more attractive for investment and provides U.S. businesses with new opportunities. This activity also supports CAATSA Goal 8 (30 percent). ..$250,000 of funding within this project contributes to meeting basic education directive... .
